step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a genomic data ingestion, curation, and analysis workflow on AWS. 1. Data comes into ad-hoc EC2 instances which write raw genomic data to FSX and push versioned pipeline containers to ECR. 2. EKS pulls versioned containers from ECR and mounts FSX storage to curate the genomic data at scale. 3. Output matrices from EKS are written to the Data Lake (S3). 4. Data Scientists/Biologists (UserCompanyAnalyst) consume curated data from the Data Lake for statistical analysis.

graph.name: Biopharma Genomic Data Processing Architecture
